info.title: Autonomous Financial Analyst & Earnings Call Intelligence API
info.description: Backend: document upload, parsing, storage and agent endpoints.

post.summary: Upload a document and run the full ingestion pipeline
post.description: Validates the file, parses it, chunks it and stores it. Re-uploading an identical file returns the existing document with duplicate=true.

get.summary: Get one document and its status

post.summary: Extract key financial metrics from a stored document
post.description: Runs the Extraction Agent on the stored text. Can take 10-60 seconds. Add ?sample=true to get fast fake sample data in the same shape.

get.summary: Metrics already extracted and saved for a document (fast, no LLM call)
get.description: Empty list until /extract has been run on the document.

post.summary: Start risk and sentiment analysis (background job)
post.description: Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued'. Poll GET /jobs/{job_id} until status is 'done' or 'failed'. Supports transcripts and CFO commentary. If a job is already queued or running for this document, that job is returned instead.

get.summary: Check a background job (poll every 2-3 seconds)
Latest finished analysis for a document (fast, no LLM call)

post.summary: Ask a question about a document, with conversation history
post.description: Omit conversation_id to start a new conversation; send the returned conversation_id with later messages so follow-up questions work. The first question on a document can take 30-60 seconds (a search index is built once); later ones are faster. Citations are exact quotes from the document.

get.summary: Get a whole conversation (to reload a chat page)

sentiment.title: Sentiment
sentiment.description: Sentiment agent output (null if that agent failed; see errors).

risk.description: Risk agent output (null if that agent failed; see errors).

message.title: Message
examples: What did management say about supply constraints?

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: Omit to start a new conversation; send it back to continue one.

message_id.title: Message Id
message_id.description: Id of the assistant message that was saved.

answered.title: Answered
answered.description: False when the document does not contain the answer (no citations).

rewritten_question.title: Rewritten Question
rewritten_question.description: For follow-ups: the standalone question actually searched. Null if unchanged.

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: Verification notes from the analyst agent.

message.title: Message
examples: Only PDF, TXT and HTML files are supported.

stub.title: Stub
stub.description: True only when ?sample=true is used (fake sample data).

saved_to_db.title: Saved To Db
saved_to_db.description: How many metrics with a value were saved to the database.

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: Problems found by the agent's verification checks (e.g. a quote not found in the source).

duplicate.title: Duplicate
duplicate.description: True if an identical file (same hash) was already ingested; the existing document_id is returned instead of creating a new one.
